investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell script block was captured on HOST-SRV-01 that defines a function to determine if a target supports alternate data streams on NTFS and uses Resolve-Path to resolve paths. The script enumerates drives and checks for NTFS format, then verifies the presence of the Add-Content -Stream parameter, which could be used to hide data in alternate streams. While the activity involves a single script block by a backup-associated user, there are potential anti-forensics or data-hiding techniques observed, warranting cautious monitoring but lacking definitive malicious indicators at this time.
